statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-70179 (GHSA-vrrp-6v32-2p8g) is an ASP.NET Core elevation of privilege issue in Negotiate authentication: when LDAP claim resolution is enabled, an authenticated identity can be associated with an unintended LDAP principal because the LDAP result is not checked against the Kerberos principal SID. Microsoft lists only the Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Negotiate NuGet package as affected, from 10.0.0 through 10.0.12, fixed in 10.0.13 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vrrp-6v32-2p8g, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/458, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.13/10.0.13.md). That package is not part of the ASP.NET Core shared framework. DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold: none of them contains Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Negotiate.dll or a Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Negotiate nupkg.

Microsoft lists only the Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Negotiate NuGet package as affected, 9.0.0 through 9.0.20 for .NET 9, fixed in 9.0.21: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vrrp-6v32-2p8g, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/458, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.21/9.0.21.md. DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold. None of these packages contains Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Negotiate.dll or a Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Negotiate nupkg. The Negotiate handler is distributed as a separate NuGet package and is not part of the Microsoft.AspNetCore.App shared framework that aspnetcore9-runtime and the SDK in dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap carry, and the source-build nupkg set in dotnet9-runtime-artifacts does not include it. The same scan found the other ASP.NET Core assemblies by name (for example Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.dll at the build's version in every build), so the search itself works. An application that needs Negotiate authentication must add the package from NuGet itself, and is then covered by Microsoft's advisory for that package, not by this owner.
